title: Atlassian Shares Surge as Revenue Jump Douses AI Fears
description: Atlassian Corp. shares surged in after-hours trading after quarterly revenue climbed, easing concerns that the software services company would be overtaken by artificial intelligence applications.

title: Markets Slip as Rising Yields Pressure Tech | The Close 8/6/2026
description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Kestra Investment Management CIO Kara Murphy, e.l.f. Beauty CEO Tarang Amin, Klaviyo CEO & Co-Founder Andrew Bialecki, CAIS Founder, Chairman, & CEO Matt Brown, Manulife John Hancock Investments Co-Chief Investment Strategist Emily Roland, Placer.ai Analytical Research Head R.J. Hottovy, GoodRx CEO Wendy Barnes, Elanco Animal Health President & CEO Jeff Simmons, RXO CEO Drew Wilkerson, & The Conference Board CEO Steve Odland.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Conference Board CEO on C-Suite Optimism, Hiring Plans
description: Steve Odland, CEO of the Conference Board, discussed the latest CEO confidence survey results, which showed an increase from 47 to 52 between the second and third quarters of 2026, moving the index into positive territory. The second quarter's negative reading was largely attributed to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly the war in Iran and the resulting spike in oil prices to around $120 per barrel. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
